lists.content:
• Serve as the primary relationship manager for a portfolio of VIP clients, delivering a highly responsive, personalized, and best-in-class client experience across Binance’s ecosystem.
  • Build strong one-on-one relationships with clients by understanding their trading behaviors, business needs, and service expectations, while providing tailored support and account management to drive long-term engagement and loyalty.
  • Maintain high availability and responsiveness to support clients in a timely manner, ensuring smooth communication, prompt issue resolution, and consistent coverage for day-to-day account needs.
  • Drive client retention, activity growth, and wallet share expansion through proactive account management, strategic engagement, and customized solutions aligned with clients’ trading and operational requirements.
  • Act as a trusted point of contact for clients, guiding them through Binance’s VIP program, platform features, product updates, and service offerings to ensure seamless account optimization and a strong overall client experience.
  • Identify relevant commercial opportunities across Binance’s product suite, including Spot, Margin, Futures, Options, OTC, Earn, and other applicable solutions, by aligning product offerings with individual client needs and preferences.
  • Monitor client activity, engagement trends, and account performance to anticipate needs, uncover growth opportunities, and provide data-backed recommendations that improve client satisfaction and business outcomes.
  • Prepare client updates, account reviews, and internal summaries to highlight client performance, service needs, risk considerations, and potential growth opportunities.
  • Partner closely with internal stakeholders including Product, Business Development, Compliance, Risk, and Operations teams to advocate for client needs, resolve issues efficiently, and enhance the overall VIP client experience.

• At least 3-5 years working experience in account management/sales function from financial/trading institutions.
  • Product knowledge from working in exchange/broker/trading firms.
  • Understand common trading strategies and how trading firms operate to make profit.
  • Strong client management skills including maintaining strong relationships, organizing client profiles and incentivise client business activities, etc.
  • Strong communication skills, ability to be flexible in a variety of situations.
  • Understanding of trading systems and API are strong plus.
  • Ability to work under pressure.
  • Passionate about crypto. Industry experience is highly preferred.
  • Bilingual English/Mandarin is required to be able to coordinate with overseas partners and stakeholders.

We are looking for an experienced Affiliate Relationship Manager (ARM) to manage and grow long-term relationships with key affiliates and channel partners across global markets.

lists.content:
• Manage and maintain relationships with existing affiliates, KOLs, trading communities, and strategic partners
  • Drive affiliate performance growth across user acquisition, trading volume, retention, and revenue contribution

About the Role
In this role, you will be responsible for developing and optimising core algorithmic models in marketing scenarios, including user behaviour prediction, profiling, ROI estimation, and traffic allocation strategies. You will design and build precision marketing models such as CTR/CVR prediction, LTV forecasting, and channel attribution analysis, leveraging user profiles, real-time behavioural data, and business objectives. A key part of the role will be creating data-driven strategies for user acquisition, retention, and repurchase, while continuously validating and improving performance through A/B testing, causal inference, and attribution analysis. You will collaborate closely with data, product, and operations teams to ensure these algorithms are effectively deployed within Binance’s marketing systems to drive measurable growth.

lists.content:
• Responsible for core algorithm models in marketing scenarios, including but not limited to user behavior prediction, user profiling, ROI estimation, and traffic allocation strategies, to improve marketing efficiency and conversion rates.
  • Build precision marketing models (such as CTR/CVR prediction, LTV forecasting, marketing channel attribution analysis, etc.) based on user profiles, real-time behavioral data, and business objectives.
  • Design data-driven algorithm strategies for user lifecycle management (acquisition, retention, repurchase) to optimize user growth and operational performance.
  • Deeply understand business needs and continuously track algorithm performance; validate and optimize models through A/B testing, causal inference, and attribution analysis, ensuring ongoing iteration and business impact.
  • Collaborate closely with data, product, and operations teams to drive the implementation of algorithms in marketing systems (e.g., user growth initiatives).

• At least 3 years of experience in related fields, with a solid foundation in algorithms and programming.
  • Master’s Degree or above in Computer Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Machine Learning, or related disciplines.
  • Proficient in at least one programming language such as Python, Scala, or Java; familiar with big data processing frameworks like Hadoop, Spark, or Flink.
  • Strong understanding of machine learning algorithms (e.g., LR, GBDT, DNN), commonly used models in marketing scenarios (e.g., Uplift Model, Lookalike), and tools such as TensorFlow or PyTorch.
  • Familiar with SQL/Hive and experienced in large-scale data cleaning, feature engineering, and model tuning.
  • Deep understanding of user growth, ad placement, and e-commerce marketing scenarios, with the ability to design algorithm solutions aligned with business goals.
  • Clear logical thinking, ability to work independently, and strong team collaboration and communication skills.

lists.content:
Financial Controllership & Day-to-Day Finance Management

  • Own end-to-end finance operations for several APAC legal entities across multiple jurisdictions, including month-end and year-end closing processes.

  • Oversee bank, asset, intercompany, accounts payable, accounts receivable, and balance sheet reconciliations.

  • Review and approve journal entries, accruals, provisions, invoices, payment requests, and other accounting records.

  • Prepare and review financial statements and management reports in accordance with applicable accounting standards and group policies.

  • Ensure timely completion of regulatory, statutory, tax, and compliance-related filings in partnership with internal teams and external advisors.

  • Manage day-to-day relationships with banks, vendors, accounting service providers, tax advisors, auditors, and other external stakeholders.

  • Partner closely with Treasury, Tax, Global Accounting, Legal, Compliance, and business teams to ensure smooth financial operations.

    • Accounting Quality & Financial Reporting

  • Ensure complete, accurate, and timely accounting for all responsible entities, including oversight of local accounting and tax vendors where applicable.

  • Review and define accounting treatments and methodologies for new business activities, products, and operational flows.

  • Maintain strong financial discipline by validating journal entries, reviewing reconciliations, and ensuring proper documentation of accounting judgments.

  • Identify and resolve accounting issues, reporting gaps, and process inconsistencies across entities and jurisdictions.

  • Support the continuous improvement of accounting systems, financial reporting processes, and closing procedures.

    • Internal Controls & Governance

  • Develop, document, and maintain business processes, accounting policies, and internal control procedures to support a strong control environment.

  • Ensure compliance with group accounting policies, delegated authority frameworks, and internal control requirements.

  • Maintain accurate, complete, and well-documented financial records to support internal reviews, audits, and regulatory inquiries.

  • Identify control gaps, operational risks, and process weaknesses, and drive timely remediation.

  • Promote a culture of accountability, transparency, and financial discipline across the region.

    • Audit Coordination

  • Lead and coordinate external audits for responsible APAC entities, ensuring timely completion and high-quality audit deliverables.

  • Act as the key point of contact for auditors, local finance teams, external accounting partners, and internal stakeholders.

  • Prepare and review audit schedules, supporting documentation, financial statements, and management representation materials.

  • Address audit findings, resolve open issues, and implement corrective actions where needed.

  • Support statutory audits, group audits, tax audits, and other regulatory reviews as required.

    • Annual Planning, Budgeting & Forecasting

  • Lead the annual budgeting and rolling forecast processes for the APAC vertical, including revenue, marketing, operating expenses, headcount, and local spend.

  • Partner with business leaders and management to align financial targets with strategic priorities.

  • Monitor actual performance against budget and forecast, identify variances, and provide clear explanations and actionable recommendations.

  • Drive high P&L forecast accuracy throughout the fiscal year to support timely business decisions and resource allocation.

  • Provide financial input into investment decisions, cost optimization initiatives, and regional growth plans.

    • Business Partnership & Strategic Analysis

  • Act as a trusted finance partner to regional and vertical management teams, providing clear, data-driven, and commercially relevant insights.

  • Build financial models, scenario analyses, and business cases to support strategic decision-making.

  • Translate financial results and trends into practical recommendations for senior stakeholders.

  • Support new market, product, and operational initiatives by assessing financial implications, risks, controls, and reporting requirements.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure Finance is embedded early in business planning and execution.

    • Process Improvement & Automation

  • Drive continuous improvement in accounting, reporting, forecasting, and finance operations processes.

  • Identify opportunities to automate manual work, streamline workflows, improve data quality, and enhance reporting efficiency.

  • Implement best practices in financial reporting, closing processes, reconciliations, and controls.

  • Partner with systems, data, and finance transformation teams to enhance enterprise-level finance tools and reporting capabilities.

  • Support scalable finance infrastructure as the business grows across the region.

    • Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of finance professionals across the region.

  • Foster a collaborative, accountable, and results-oriented team culture.

  • Set clear priorities, performance expectations, and development plans for team members.

  • Partner with Central Finance to deliver training on accounting standards, financial policies, reporting requirements, and internal controls.

  • Build finance capabilities to support business complexity, regulatory expectations, and organizational growth.

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related discipline. CPA, CMA, ACCA, CA, MBA, or Master’s degree preferred.

  • 10+ years of relevant finance experience, including controllership, financial accounting, financial planning and analysis, audit, or finance business partnering.

  • Prior experience as a Finance Manager, Financial Controller, Regional Controller, or Finance Business Partner within a multinational, listed company, technology, fintech, financial services, or high-growth environment preferred.

  • Strong knowledge of accounting principles, financial reporting, statutory reporting, tax filings, general ledger operations, and month-end/year-end closing processes.

  • Experience managing financial operations across multiple APAC jurisdictions is strongly preferred.

  • Strong understanding of internal controls, audit processes, accounting policies, and financial governance frameworks.

  • Hands-on experience with enterprise-level ERP, accounting, consolidation, and financial planning systems.

  • Excellent financial modelling, analytical, problem-solving, and business partnering skills.

  • Strong executive presence with the ability to communicate clearly and influence senior stakeholders.

  • Highly proactive, detail-oriented, and able to operate independently with limited supervision.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, ambiguous, and evolving environment.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet tight deadlines, and bring structure to complex situations.

  • Excellent interpersonal, communication, and people leadership skills.

  • Fluency in written and spoken English is required. Mandarin language capability is a plus for collaboration with cross-regional stakeholders.

  • Demonstrated interest in digital assets, crypto, blockchain technology, fintech, or Web3 is an advantage.

    • Preferred Attributes

  • Strong ownership mindset with the ability to operate both strategically and hands-on.

  • Commercially minded finance leader who can balance control, compliance, and business enablement.

  • Experience working with distributed, cross-functional, and multicultural teams.

  • Ability to simplify complex financial topics for non-finance stakeholders.

  • High integrity, strong judgment, and commitment to maintaining robust financial governance.

    •

• Sustainable Points System Design & Development: Lead the end-to-end development of a sustainable points ecosystem, define core rules (including points tasks, tiered levels, reward redemption, etc.) and formulate the total points issuance, as well as complete mechanisms for points acquisition, consumption, recycling, validity period and inflation control. Ensure stable value anchoring and controllable operational costs.
  • Data-Driven Operations & Risk Control: Establish a full set of core metrics (covering redemption rate, inflation rate, cost expenditure, etc.) design anti-cheating and anti-abuse strategies, and guarantee the long-term stability and healthy operation of the points system.
  • Cross-Team Collaboration & Implementation: Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Design, business BUs, regional teams, Risk, PR, Customer Service and other stakeholders to develop benefit display and user communication guidelines. Drive the seamless integration of the points system with business activities, lower user comprehension barriers and reduce complaint risks.

• 5+ Years of Professional Experience: Proven expertise in user incentive programs, membership systems or economic system design across gaming, e-commerce, fintech and other related industries. Must have a track record of leading end-to-end successful projects, such as building a points system from 0 to 1 and driving its full implementation.
  • Strong Logical & Mathematical Competence: Capable of independently completing points balance calculation, cost budgeting and long-term inflation modeling. Proficiency in advanced Excel formulas and basic SQL is a mandatory requirement.
  • Fintech & Compliance Acumen: Solid understanding of financial product logic (including spot trading, futures, wealth management, etc.); familiar with investor protection protocols and compliance boundaries, especially in avoiding incentives for high-risk behaviors.
  • Excellent Cross-Team Collaboration Skills: Ability to efficiently align and reach consensus with cross-functional teams including compliance, risk control, product development and other core departments, driving project progress smoothly.
  • Bilingual English/Mandarin is required to be able to coordinate with overseas partners and stakeholders. Additional languages would be a strong advantage

• Prior experience in game numerical planning: Hands-on expertise in numerical design and balance adjustment within the gaming industry, which helps optimize the stability and rationality of points economic systems.
  • Fintech or securities brokerage background: In-depth knowledge of cross-regional compliance differences and regulatory requirements, capable of adapting incentive system design to diverse regional regulatory rules.
  • Advanced data analysis capabilities: Proficiency in Python or SQL, with the ability to independently build and optimize points liability forecasting models to support refined operation and risk control of the system.

descriptionPlain:
Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, Web3 features, and more. We leverage the power of digital assets and blockchain to build an inclusive financial ecosystem to advance the freedom of money and improve financial access for people around the world.


About the Team
The Binance Pay&Card team is revolutionizing the way people transact and manage their finances globally. Binance Pay is a cutting-edge payment solution that enables users to send, receive, and pay with crypto seamlessly. Join us to be part of a dynamic team driving the future of digital payments and financial technology.
Role Overview
As a Backend Architect on the Pay&Card Team, you will be responsible for architecting and building card-related systems end to end. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to design scalable, secure, and compliant infrastructure that supports card systems and lifecycle management.

lists.content:
• Architect, build, and maintain backend systems for card issuing and card lifecycle management

  • Lead the technical design and implementation of card certification processes (Visa, MasterCard, Apple Pay / Google Pay onboarding programs)

  • Define and drive the system architecture, service boundaries, and integration patterns for card platform services

  • Ensure system reliability, scalability, and compliance with payment network standards

  • Collaborate with product, compliance, and engineering teams to translate business requirements into technical specifications

  • Establish engineering best practices, code quality standards, and technical documentation for the team

  • Work hands-on — this is a builder role, not a pure advisory position

• 8+ years of backend engineering experience with strong Java / Spring expertise

  • Direct experience building or maintaining a card system  

  • Experience with card certification processes and/or card onboarding programs

  • Strong system design and architecture skills, with experience in distributed systems and high-throughput payment infrastructure

  • Understanding of card network standards, payment flows, and compliance requirements

• Experience at a fintech, startup, or crypto company that has issued cards

  • Familiarity with card lifecycle management, tokenization, and payment gateway integrations

  • Experience working in agile, fast-paced environments with short release cycles

lists.content:
• Own the full development lifecycle — requirements, design, coding, testing, and deployment — for low-latency, high-throughput trading systems.
  • Collaborate with Quant/Research teams to build and enhance pricing, hedging, and delta-residual models.
  • Work with trading and product teams to develop new products and improve existing ones.
  • Build and maintain trading infrastructure to handle large-scale positions, quotes, and orders.
  •  Implement and improve risk management and position-monitoring tools; identify and resolve system bottlenecks.
  • Mentor junior developers; lead design and code reviews.
  • Integrate AI coding agents (e.g. Claude Code) into daily workflows — covering project planning, technical design, code generation, testing, and code/security review.
  • Be available for flexible hours to support production incidents when needed.

• 2+ years of experience in the full lifecycle of Java and/or Python application development.
  • Strong grasp of software design, architecture, and system integration.
  • Solid knowledge of event processing, multi-threading, enterprise integration patterns, REST/web services.
  • Hands-on experience with Spring / Spring Boot, MyBatis, MySQL, Redis, Kafka, and cloud-native deployment.
  • Experience building high-availability, high-throughput, low-latency systems.
  • Practical experience with AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or similar) in production workflows.
  • Fluency in English for coordination with overseas partners and stakeholders.
  • Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field preferred.
    •

• Experience at trading firms, investment banks, hedge funds, brokerages, or crypto exchanges.
  • Understanding of derivatives products — options pricing, Greeks, hedging strategies.
  • Familiarity with agent-driven workflows: writing CLAUDE.md / rules files, building custom skills, integrating MCP servers (Jira, Confluence, GitHub), and designing review loops for reliable agent output.
  • Contributions to internal developer tooling, agent skills, or AI-assisted engineering productivity.

Current university students and recent graduates.

We are looking for motivated and enthusiastic Brand KOL BD individuals to join our dynamic team. This is a fantastic opportunity for a young, fresh graduate with strong communication skills to gain hands-on experience in public relations and influencer management within the fast-paced crypto industry.


As a Brand KOL BD member, you will assist in building and maintaining relationships with KOLs, support event coordination, and help manage communications during critical situations. You will be the face of our brand at KOL events and play a key role in ensuring smooth collaboration and positive public perception.


If you are passionate about communication, eager to learn, and ready to contribute to a leading crypto company, we would love to hear from you!

lists.content:
• Assist in identifying and engaging KOLs aligned with our brand values.

  • Support the Brand team in organizing and attending KOL events, meetings, and networking activities.

  • Act as a liaison between the company and KOLs, ensuring timely and professional communication.

  • Help manage crisis communications and support resolution efforts with KOLs during sensitive situations.

  • Prepare and deliver clear, concise updates and reports on KOL activities and public sentiment.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align KOL strategies with overall PR goals.

  • Maintain a professional and presentable image as a representative of the company.

• Recent graduate or final-year student in Communications, Marketing, Public Relations, or related fields.

  • Fluency in English is required to be able to coordinate with overseas partners and stakeholders. Additional languages would be an advantage.

  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build rapport and maintain professional relationships.

  • Presentable, confident, and comfortable attending events and engaging with influencers.

  • Proactive, detail-oriented, and able to work effectively in a fast-paced environment.

  • Interest in the crypto/blockchain industry is a plus but not mandatory.

  • Ability to handle sensitive situations calmly and professionally.

lists.content:
• Support the design and development of AI agent workflows and LLM-powered application components

  • Build and test prompt strategies, retrieval flows, tool-use logic, orchestration patterns, and backend integrations

  • Assist in defining evaluation metrics, running benchmarks, and analyzing failure cases

  • Improve system performance across quality, latency, reliability, safety, and cost

  • Use AI coding tools as a normal part of your workflow to accelerate development and problem-solving

  • Collaborate with engineers and cross-functional teams to understand how production AI systems are designed, deployed, and improved

  • Contribute to Backend services, APIs, internal tools, or lightweight user interfaces when needed

  • Good problem-solving ability and comfort working with APIs, debugging, and data

  • Strong curiosity about LLMs, AI agents, automation, and real-world system design

  • Ability to break down ambiguous problems and move from idea to working prototype

  • Comfortable learning quickly and working in a fast-moving environment

  • Available for a 6-month full-time commitment

  • Familiarity with OpenAI APIs, Anthropic APIs, Hugging Face, LangChain, vector databases, or workflow tools

descriptionPlain:
Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, Web3 features, and more. We leverage the power of digital assets and blockchain to build an inclusive financial ecosystem to advance the freedom of money and improve financial access for people around the world.


Binance is the global blockchain company behind the world’s largest digital asset exchange by trading volume and users, serving a greater mission to accelerate cryptocurrency adoption and increase the freedom of money.
 
Are you looking to be a part of the most influential company in the blockchain industry and contribute to the cryptocurrency revolution that is changing the world?
 
We are looking for a proactive and driven early careers talent to join our Binance Academy team. You will support our team to help build long-term partnerships with student organizations and universities. On top of that, you will also develop and execute various outreach activities and communication strategies on blockchain and crypto. You will help us to build web3 courses in various formats that will facilitate crypto adoption among learners and connect with schools across the globe. 
 
The successful early careers talent will also play a key part in managing our newly formed student ambassador program in their allocated region and contribute to the overall success of the team by closely working with other Binance local teams across the globe. In collaboration with a Business Development Specialist, you will help to devise innovative ways to build partnerships and encourage students to participate in various Binance programs both on and off campus.

descriptionPlain:
We are seeking a dedicated and dynamic individual to join our affiliate team for a 6 month opportunity, focusing on managing an expanding network of affiliates. This role primarily involves collaborating with prominent KOLs to ensure the effectiveness of their promotional efforts. A significant aspect of the position includes liaising with various internal departments to equip affiliates with the necessary assets and tools to attract more users to Binance. lists.content: We are building cutting-edge AI systems that enable the next generation of intelligent applications. Our team focuses on developing AI agents, benchmarking datasets, and robust infrastructure to support real-world deployments at scale. As part of our engineering-driven culture, you'll be exposed to a fast-paced environment where experimentation, collaboration, and innovation are encouraged.

- Contribute to the design and development of AI agents integrated into live production systems
- Help build and maintain benchmark datasets to evaluate agent performance, accuracy, and safety
- Design and refine prompts, tool integrations, and agent workflows
- Implement, test, and optimize services and tooling across the stack — backend, data, scripting, automation, and glue code
- Collaborate closely with senior engineers on system design, multi-agent orchestration, and deployment
- Participate in code reviews, debugging, and documentation to ensure best practices
- Work in a team environment that encourages mentorship, knowledge sharing, and hands-on learning

- Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
- Strong programming fundamentals — language-agnostic, but practical experience with at least one of Python, Go, TypeScript, or similar
- Solid understanding of software engineering principles (data structures, algorithms, version control)
- Familiarity or working knowledge of any AI agent framework (e.g., OpenClaw, hermes-agent, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen)
- Interest in AI, data-driven systems, and building tools for real-world applications
- Good communication skills and willingness to learn quickly

- AI-native working style — you naturally reach for AI tools in your daily workflow, not as an afterthought but as a core part of how you think, build, and solve problems
- Eager to learn and open-minded — you stay current with the latest technologies and aren't afraid to adopt new frameworks, tools, or paradigms before they're mainstream
- First-principles thinker who's comfortable redesigning workflows rather than just optimizing existing ones

- Experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, or building tools on top of AI models
- Exposure to multi-agent systems or agent orchestration patterns
- Familiarity with Docker, cloud platforms, or CI/CD pipelines
- Machine learning knowledge is a plus, but not required

Binance is trusted by more than 320 million people in 100+ countries for its industry-leading security, transparency, trading engine speed, protections for investors, and unmatched portfolio of digital asset products and offerings from trading and finance to education, research, social good, payments, institutional services, and Web3 features. Binance is devoted to building an inclusive crypto ecosystem to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world with crypto as the fundamental means.
 
About Binance Accelerator Program
Binance Accelerator Program (BAP) is a 3-6 month internship program designed for Early Career talent to have firsthand experience in the rapidly expanding digital assets space. You will be given the opportunity to develop your skills at Binance and understand what it’s like to work at the world's leading blockchain ecosystem. As part of your internship in the BAP, there will also be opportunities for networking and development, which will expand your professional network and build transferable skills to propel you forward in your career. Learn about the BAP Program HERE.
 
Who may apply
Current university students and recent graduates.
*Terms of employment / engagement shall be subject to contract and local applicable laws

About the Role

Want to work on AI that engineers use every day? As part of the Binance Accelerator Program, you'll help build internal tools that make developers faster and less blocked. Real work, real ownership, real impact.

lists.content:
• Build AI-powered tools like coding assistants, knowledge retrieval systems, and workflow automation
  • Develop LLM-powered applications for code generation, code understanding, and test automation
  • Work with engineering teams to identify pain points and ship AI-driven solutions
  • Experiment with Prompt Engineering, RAG, and AI Agents
  • Explore and adopt emerging AI technologies as they evolve

• Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science or a related field
  • Can code in at least one language — Python, Java, Go, or JavaScript
  • Basic understanding of how LLMs work and have used tools like ChatGPT or Copilot
  • Comfortable with APIs and how systems connect
  • You take initiative — you don't wait to be told what to do next.
  • Bilingual English/Mandarin is required to be able to coordinate with overseas partners and stakeholders

lists.content:
1. AI Products: Work as a core member on company-level AI initiatives, from concept to launch — covering industry research, product definition, prototype review, user testing, and post-launch data analysis.
  2. Defi (Stablecoin) Products: Track market trends, leading competitors, and on-chain data; produce decision-ready research memos. Contribute to product design, write PRDs, follow projects through development and launch, and support early-stage ecosystem partnership conversations.
  3. Cross-Functional Proeject Management: Act as a key coordinator across multiple parallel workstreams — driving alignment on goals, pacing, and risks to keep complex projects on track.
  4. Decision Support: Help produce internal and external materials, bilingual (CN/EN) writing and translation, and industry/data insights that feed directly into business decisions.
  5. Use AI tools (Claude, Cursor, etc.) as a daily working habit to scale personal output.

1. Currently enrolled in Finance or Computer Science (or related); senior undergrad or graduate students preferred. Dual-degree (Finance + CS / AI) is a plus.
  2. Fully bilingual in Chinese and English — able to write memos, emails, and meeting notes independently in both languages and switch fluently in bilingual settings.
  3. Genuine interest and basic understanding. Hands-on trading or on-chain experience preferred — able to clearly articulate what you've used and the reasoning behind your decisions.
  4. Active interest and hands-on exploration in AI, with demonstrable personal projects, demos, writing, or GitHub work. Background in HCI or big-data analytics is a plus.
  5. Self-directed and structured — able to break down ambiguous problems and move forward independently, with consistent output in a fast-paced environment.
  6. Strong communication and coordination skills — able to keep information and progress flowing across multiple teams.

  Nice to Have

  1. Entrepreneurial experience, leadership in student organizations, or large-scale event coordination.
  2. Prior internships at top tech companies, financial institutions, or Web3 projects.
  3. Public research or writing output (industry reports, in-depth posts, newsletters, etc.).
  4. Your own perspective on the Defi space or major crypto products.

About the Role
This position is for students who are excited about applying AI to improve how software is built. You will work on real-world projects that explore how large language models and AI tools can enhance developer productivity and engineering workflows.
You’ll gain hands-on experience building AI-powered tools and contributing to a growing internal AI platform.
 

 
What You Will Do
Assist in building AI tools such as coding assistants, automation scripts, and knowledge Q&A systems
Support the development of LLM-based applications (e.g., prompt optimization, lightweight RAG pipelines)
Contribute to initiatives that improve engineering efficiency and developer experience
Help test, iterate, and document internal AI tools and platforms
Research and experiment with emerging AI technologies and use cases
 

 
What We're Looking For
Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field
Proficiency in at least one programming language (Python preferred)
Strong fundamentals in programming and problem-solving
Interest in AI, especially large language models (LLMs)
Experience using tools like ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar
Familiarity with basic software development workflows (e.g., Git, debugging)
Good communication skills and willingness to learn
 

 
Bonus Points
Experience with AI-related projects (e.g., chatbots, NLP, automation tools)
Exposure to Prompt Engineering or AI-assisted development workflows
Coursework or basic knowledge in machine learning or NLP
Personal projects, technical blogs, or GitHub portfolio

lists.content:
• Design and run experiments in reasoning model training, post-training alignment, test-time compute scaling, and systematic model evaluation — grounded in financial and crypto-native problem settings
  • Implement model variants, training pipelines (including RLVR-based approaches), and evaluation frameworks in PyTorch and the Hugging Face ecosystem
  • Synthesize recent work from NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, and ACL to sharpen active research directions — not just track the field, but translate it into testable ideas
  • Apply LLM reasoning to crypto-native data: on-chain signals, market microstructure, and multi-modal market intelligence — research opportunities that don't exist anywhere else
  • Maintain rigorous experiment tracking and reproducibility standards (W&B or equivalent)
  • Partner with applied engineering to understand how research translates into production systems — and what constraints actually matter

• Currently pursuing a Master's or PhD in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related field (preferably graduating between 2026 to 2028)
  • Strong Python and PyTorch fundamentals; C++ or Rust exposure is a bonus 
  • Comfortable using AI-assisted development tools as a natural part of your research workflow — not as a crutch, but as leverage
  • Solid grounding in transformer architectures, LLM pretraining, and the shift toward reasoning-capable models
  • You form opinions about research, not just summaries of it

lists.content:

  • Strong knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
  • Hands-on experience in front-end and back-end application development through coursework, personal projects, research, or internships.
  • Exposure to at least one major cloud platform, such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Alibaba Cloud, or Tencent Cloud.
  • Familiarity with Git and collaborative software development workflows.
  • Soft Skills
  • Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail.
  • Experience coordinating projects or collaborating across teams through student organizations, research projects, internships, or extracurricular activities.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and eager to learn new technologies and business domains.

lists.content:

lists.content:
This internship is part of Tech Seeds 2026 — our program to identify and develop AI-native young talent. As an Applied AI Agent Engineer young talent, you will take on a hands-on builder role at the intersection of LLMs and production systems, working alongside full-time engineers on agent workflows, tool integrations, backend services, and AI system architecture from day one.

This is not a shadowing role. You will own deliverables, run experiments, and ship code that matters.

• Support the design and development of AI agent workflows and LLM-powered application components

  • Build and test prompt strategies, retrieval flows, tool-use logic, orchestration patterns, and backend integrations

  • Assist in defining evaluation metrics, running benchmarks, and analyzing failure cases

  • Improve system performance across quality, latency, reliability, safety, and cost

  • Use AI coding tools as a normal part of your workflow to accelerate development and problem-solving

  • Collaborate with engineers and cross-functional teams to understand how production AI systems are designed, deployed, and improved

  • Contribute to backend services, APIs, internal tools, or lightweight user interfaces when needed

• Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related field

  • Expected graduation in 2026 or 2027

  • Solid programming skills in Python or Java; familiarity with backend engineering is preferred

  • Good problem-solving ability and comfort working with APIs, debugging, and data

  • Strong curiosity about LLMs, AI agents, automation, and real-world system design

  • Ability to break down ambiguous problems and move from idea to working prototype

  • Comfortable learning quickly and working in a fast-moving environment

  • Available for a 6-month full-time commitment

• Personal projects or coursework involving LLM applications, agent systems, automation, or AI-assisted development

  • Familiarity with OpenAI APIs, Anthropic APIs, Hugging Face, LangChain, vector databases, or workflow tools

  • Experience with Git, databases, backend services, or cloud platforms

lists.text: What Makes You a Fit for Tech Seeds 2026
lists.content: You are curious, proactive, and builder-minded. You already experiment with AI tools on your own, learn quickly, and want to turn AI ideas into practical systems that work in the real world.

lists.content:
You'll work directly on the AI systems powering Binance AI Products and next-generation agentic trading features — alongside the full-time algorithm team, on real production challenges.

You own deliverables, run experiments, and ship code that matters. You build components of AI systems (agents, pipelines, evaluation tools), debug real systems, and work with engineers to ship features that reach users.

This is not a "watch and learn" program. You are expected to build, contribute, and ship.

• Contribute to the design and development of LLM-powered pipelines for agentic trading — including reasoning agent components, tool-use frameworks via MCP, and automated workflow execution across crypto markets.

  • Build and evaluate prompt engineering strategies, test-time scaling approaches, and retrieval architectures for crypto-native data sources — on-chain data, market feeds, news, and sentiment signals.

  • Design and run model evaluation experiments — defining quality metrics for agent reasoning in financial contexts, executing benchmarks, and synthesizing results into actionable findings.

  • Analyze agent performance characteristics in live trading scenarios — covering decision accuracy, latency, reliability, and adversarial robustness.

  • Apply AI-native development practices using agentic coding tools as a standard part of the engineering workflow — writing and executing Python code for strategy logic, data pipelines, and agent evaluation.

• Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or related technical field.

  • Expected graduation in 2026 or 2027.

  • Strong Python programming skills with demonstrated AI-native development practices — you use agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot Workspace) as a core part of your workflow.

  • Foundational understanding of how large language models work — attention mechanisms, prompting, and the difference between standard generation and reasoning models.

  • Structured problem-solving approach and ability to operate independently on defined tasks.

About the Team

Binance AI Pro is building the next generation of AI-native experiences within Binance.

At the core of AI Pro is an agentic system that can understand user intent, reason through multi-step tasks, retrieve information, call tools, and safely execute actions across Binance's ecosystem.

As a Backend Engineer Intern, you'll work directly on the Agent Runtime and AI infrastructure behind these experiences — from intent routing and tool orchestration to evaluation, observability, and reliability. We're looking for strong technical students who enjoy going deep — people who are excited by LLM Agents, systems, algorithms, and experimentation, and wants to work on real production AI systems alongside experienced Backend, Data Science, and Algorithm engineers.

You will have the opportunity to turn ideas from prototype → benchmark → production, and see your work directly impact how AI Pro behaves at scale.

lists.content:
• Build and improve core components of the Agent Runtime, including intent routing, query rewriting, RAG, tool/skill orchestration, and multi-step agent workflows.
  • Design and optimize Tool Server / Tool Calling capabilities, including tool discovery, execution, result handling, and integration with web search, market data, and internal services.
  • Develop evaluation datasets and evaluation harnesses to measure routing accuracy, answer quality, tool-use performance, and agent reliability.
  • Investigate and improve Agent quality, including failure analysis, regression detection, prompt / workflow optimization, and guardrail effectiveness.
  • Improve system observability and reliability through tracing, metrics, logging, dashboards, and production monitoring.
  • Debug issues across asynchronous services and agent pipelines, and build integration tests using mocked LLM responses and replayable evaluation cases.
  • Work closely with Backend, Data Science, and Algorithm engineers to experiment, benchmark, and bring AI capabilities into production.

• Strong Python programming skills and solid software engineering fundamentals.
  • Strong understanding of algorithms, data structures, and problem solving; able to reason about system behavior and trade-offs.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM applications or Agent systems, through research, coursework, internships, or projects.
  • Familiarity with concepts such as RAG, Tool Calling, Function Calling, Prompting, Agent workflows, or LLM evaluation.
  • Able to work comfortably with real codebases, APIs, asynchronous services, testing, CI/CD, and code review.
  • Strong debugging and analytical ability, with a mindset of "understand why it fails, not just make it work."

• Experience with Agent frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, AgentScope, LlamaIndex, or similar.
  • Experience with MCP / Tool ecosystems / Agent Runtime.
  • Experience building Benchmark / Evaluation / LLM testing infrastructure.
  • Familiarity with vector search, embeddings, RAG evaluation, or LLM observability.
  • Experience with Redis, Kafka, Docker, Kubernetes, or cloud-native systems.
  • Exposure to LLM security, guardrails, prompt-injection defense, or tool-use safety.
  • Experience with model inference, latency optimization, or cost optimization.

• Ship real features to a production AI Agent used by Binance users.
  • Work on the Agent Runtime and AI infrastructure, rather than only application-layer development.
  • Learn from senior Backend, Data Science and Algorithm engineers.
  • Gain hands-on experience across the modern LLM application stack: Agent Runtime, RAG, Tool Calling, Evaluation, LLMOps and AI Safety.
  • Own meaningful engineering projects end-to-end, from problem definition → implementation → evaluation → production.

About the team:  We are the Big Data Infrastructure team at Binance, responsible for the stability and cost efficiency of the company's core data platform. Our systems cover Spark/YARN job monitoring and governance, S3 storage cost analysis, data lineage and quality management, and automated operations tooling.

lists.content:
• Spark / YARN Job Optimization
  • Analyze job resource usage and identify inefficiencies (CPU idle, memory waste, timeouts, small file problems, etc.)
  • Build job profiling systems: job classification, resource baseline modeling, historical trend analysis
  • Produce optimization reports and drive business owners to implement improvements
  • AI-Driven Automation & Tooling
  • Use AI coding tools (Cursor / Copilot / Claude, etc.) fluently to accelerate development and tool delivery
  • Participate in EMR / S3 cost optimization projects: analyze high-cost jobs and storage, identify waste, and drive owners to take action
  • Develop automated ops scripts: scheduled health checks, anomaly alerting, data governance policy auto-deployment
  • Help build internal SaaS tooling to systematize and productize repetitive manual operations
  •  Monitoring & Alerting
  • Maintain and improve existing monitoring systems (Prometheus metrics, alerts, log analysis)
  • Participate in Flink / Spark job health monitoring development
  • Assist with capacity alerting and governance for disk, S3, and other storage layers

• Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
  • Proficient in Python — able to write clean, maintainable scripts and tools independently
  • **Must be fluent in AI coding tools (Cursor / Copilot / ChatGPT / Claude, etc.) for development and troubleshooting** — this is a hard requirement; please think carefully before applying if you don't use AI tools regularly
  • Comfortable with Linux: running programs on servers, reading logs, debugging issues

lists.text: Bonus Points (one or two is plenty)
lists.content:
• Have used Spark / Hive / Flink, even just in coursework
  • Familiar with AWS basics (S3, EMR, Athena)
  • Have written Shell scripts or set up crontab scheduled tasks
  • Have used Kafka, Prometheus, or any message queue / monitoring system
  • Have completed a full project using AI tools and can clearly explain how and where you used them
  • Any real project experience: open source contributions, competitions, lab projects, etc.
  • Bilingual English/Mandarin is an added advantage to be able to coordinate with overseas partners and stakeholders.

lists.content:
•    Support the development and optimization of computer vision models to enhance our product features.
•    Write clean, efficient Python code using modern frameworks such as PyTorch (and TensorFlow where relevant) for model training, inference, and deployment.
•    Assist with integrating computer vision solutions into existing systems and workflows.
•    Stay curious about the latest advancements in computer vision, large language models (LLMs), and multimodal AI, and share fresh ideas with the team.
•    Participate in code reviews, stand-ups, and team discussions to build strong engineering practices.
•    Contribute to research experiments and help translate promising ideas into practical prototypes.
•    Collaborate with cross-functional teams (engineering, product, data) in an agile setting.

• Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, or a related field.

  • Proficiency in Python and experience (or strong interest) with PyTorch or TensorFlow.
  • Familiarity with KYC pipelines, document analysis, or OCR processes is a strong plus.
  • Any personal projects, GitHub contributions, Kaggle competitions, or academic research in computer vision is highly valued.

• Experience building agentic AI systems — autonomous agents that can reason, plan, and act across tools and workflows.

• Draft, edit, and proofread content quickly and accurately against deadlines and briefs, including blog posts, CRM, research reports, and more

This project is dedicated to developing and researching AI Agent decision-quality assurance and continuous improvement for compliance and KYC-related initiatives. Core work involves applying statistical and data-analytical methods to perform root-cause analysis of AI Agent decisions, as well as researching and developing model optimization algorithms to drive iterative project improvements.

lists.content:
• Participate in and conduct research on decision-quality analysis and continuous improvement of the project
  • Develop and research statistical algorithms and machine learning models; use SQL and Python to validate and build production applications of large language models (LLMs)
  • Extract and analyze data to validate hypotheses and deliver quantifiable, actionable conclusions with clear implementation directions
  • Assist in producing analytical reports and technical documentation; collaborate with the team to drive project progress

• Master's degree or above in a STEM field (CS, Statistics, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, EE, or related)
  • Python proficiency: able to independently write data processing and analysis scripts (pandas, numpy, etc.)
  • At least one end-to-end project where you drove the work from start to finish with a tangible deliverable
  • Statistics / ML fundamentals: solid understanding of statistical models, machine learning model training and classification evaluation metrics (precision, recall, confusion matrix, FP/FN, and their business implications)
  • English reading and writing fluency (all project documentation and code are in English)
  • Strong teamwork mindset and a sense of ownership/responsibility for the project
  • Experience using AI coding assistants (Copilot / Cursor / Claude / ChatGPT) on real projects with a verification mindset (not blindly trusting AI output)
  • LLM / Prompt Engineering / Agent project experience
  • SQL data extraction experience
  • Background in financial risk, KYC, compliance, or anti-fraud
    •  
    If you are someone who can wrangle messy data into actionable conclusions, leverages AI for efficiency but never takes its output on faith, and operates with genuine ownership — a STEM Master's-level candidate - we want you!

lists.content:
We are looking for someone who is careful, detail-oriented, and interested in LLMs and AI Agents.

What you will work on: You will support AI-related projects in compliance and risk control areas, including:
  • KYC (Know Your Customer): helping improve processes for identity verification, document review, and user onboarding
  • KYB (Know Your Business): supporting business entity verification and related due diligence workflows
  • EDD (Enhanced Due Diligence): assisting with more complex review cases, risk signals, and investigation support
  • Helping test and optimize LLM/Agent-based workflows for compliance operations
  • Reviewing prompts, automation logic, and model outputs
  • Documenting findings, edge cases, and process improvements
  • Supporting small-scale implementation, evaluation, and operational analysis tasks

• Undergraduate or postgraduate background in business data analytics, computer science or a related field.
  •  Some hands-on experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, or AI Agents
  • Basic coding or scripting ability is a plus
  • Interest in compliance, risk control, or operational efficiency is a plusIf you are reliable, practical, and excited about applying AI to real business workflows
  • Responsible and patient in repetitive or process-heavy work
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Mandarin to be able to coordinate with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Capable of creating clear documentation and presentations.
  • Strong sense of ownership, with a collaborative, hands-on approach to problem-solving.
  • Ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams and adapt to a fast-paced, evolving environment.

lists.content:
We are looking for a Data Scientist early careers talent to join the Binance Square team and support the development of next-generation recommendation and community intelligence systems.

Binance Square is evolving from a content feed into an intelligent Web3 financial community, helping users discover market trends, trading ideas, hot topics, and high-quality creators. In this role, you will work closely with data scientists, algorithm engineers, product managers, and business teams to improve content distribution, user engagement, and community growth through data-driven recommendation strategies.

Analyze user behavior, content quality, creator performance, and feed consumption patterns to identify opportunities for recommendation improvement.
Support the optimization of key recommendation scenarios, including Feed, Hot Tab, Topic, News, Trading Analysis, and creator distribution.
Build and refine data metrics for content quality, user interest profiling, creator quality, community health, and trading-related content.
Participate in recommendation strategy design, including recall, ranking, cold-start, diversity, personalization, and traffic allocation.
Conduct A/B testing, metric monitoring, bad-case analysis, and experiment deep dives to evaluate algorithm and product impact.
Explore the application of LLMs and multimodal models in content understanding, topic tagging, hot event detection, and personalized distribution.
Work with engineering teams to improve data pipelines, feature logging, experiment tracking, and recommendation system efficiency.

Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field.
Strong analytical skills and solid understanding of statistics, machine learning, and data mining.
Proficient in SQL and at least one programming language such as Python.
Familiar with recommendation systems, ranking models, user profiling, A/B testing, or causal analysis.
Good business sense and ability to translate data insights into product or algorithm improvements.
Strong communication skills and ability to work cross-functionally with product, algorithm, engineering, and operations teams.
Interest in Web3, crypto, financial markets, online communities, or content recommendation is a plus.

lists.content: We are looking for a seasoned Infrastructure Security Engineer Intern to join our ranks and help us to secure and automate our platform. Ideal person for this role can not only handle complex technical challenges, but also have the ability to make things simple and intuitive. You should have an aptitude for identifying technical debt and the ability to standardize processes and systems in zero-trust fashion

- Design and deploy security solutions to monitor, harden entire infra system in AWS
- Implement new, and update existing security measures for the protection of Binance.com infrastructure
- Utilize log ingestion platform for security analytics and identification of tactics, techniques and patterns of attackers
- Provides solutions to audited access, risk assessments in permission escalation, and vulnerability assessments
- Build models or leverage LLM for anomaly detection

- A strong background with AWS or other cloud technologies
- Deep expertise with GNU/Linux systems
- Previous development experience, preferably in Python, node.js or Go
- Familiarity with cloud-native security tools and practices, such as IAM, Secrets management, runtime protection, and network segmentation
- Experience with logging systems and log analysis
- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills

- Extensive experience with Terraform and Teleport. 
- Experience with containerization technologies, such as Docker and Kubernetes.
- Experience with infrastructure vulnerability scanning, vulnerability management and patching practices
- Bilingual English/Mandarin is required to be able to coordinate with overseas partners and stakeholders

We are looking for a passionate and creative Graphic Design early career talent to join our MENA marketing team at Binance. This role offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in delivering high-impact design assets for regional and global campaigns across digital, social, events, and out-of-home (OOH) channels. You will work closely with experienced designers and marketing professionals to support creative delivery, localization, and campaign scaling efforts.

lists.content:
• Creative Design Support:  
  • Assist in interpreting creative briefs to produce engaging design assets for MENA and global campaigns, including key visuals, social media content, digital marketing materials, events, and OOH.  
  • Support the translation of creative direction into on-brand designs for daily, weekly, and seasonal campaigns.  
  • Collaborate with design leads, project managers, copywriters, and senior designers to contribute to integrated creative campaigns.  
  • Help coordinate with local marketing teams to support regional creative initiatives.  
  • Contribute ideas to innovate and elevate Binance’s brand presence through design.
    •  
  • Localization & Campaign Assistance:
  • Support the localization and adaptation of global creative assets to ensure cultural relevance for MENA markets.  
  • Assist in designing and localizing paid advertising campaign materials.  
  • Help the acquisition and retention teams by delivering engaging digital campaign assets that drive brand awareness and user engagement.  
  • Monitor campaign performance insights and assist in applying learnings to improve creative output.  
  • Stay informed on competitor activity, brand trends, and social media design innovations.
    •  
  • Creative Operations & Collaboration  
  • Assist in improving creative workflows and processes alongside design leads and program managers.  
  • Work closely with global and regional marketing, social media, events, and campaign teams to maintain a consistent omni-channel brand experience.  
  • Manage assigned tasks independently to meet deadlines and quality standards.  
  • Support coordination with third-party agencies and freelancers on creative projects.  
  • Build positive working relationships with Binance’s global marketing teams to align on creative vision.

• Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree or professional qualification in graphic design, digital design, visual communication, or a related field.  
  • Strong interest in design with some practical experience through coursework, personal projects, or internships.  
  • Basic proficiency in Figma and / or Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator); familiarity with 3D software or generative AI tools is a plus.  
  • Good understanding of the end-to-end design process: concept development, production, and delivery.  
  • Creative thinker with a keen visual eye and eagerness to learn and generate innovative ideas.  
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and take initiative on assigned tasks.  
  • Familiarity with project management tools such as Asana, Microsoft Office, and Google Workspace is desirable.  
  • Passion for the crypto industry or fast-paced sectors like lifestyle, sports, or fashion is a bonus.
  • Fluency in English is required to be able to coordinate with overseas partners and stakeholders. Additional languages would be an advantage.

lists.content:
• Assist in the training, fine-tuning, and evaluation of Large Language Models (LLMs) using public and in-house datasets.
  • Support the development and optimization of AI agents, including prompt engineering, memory modules, planning strategies, and integration with external tools.
  • Design, implement, and manage data annotation pipelines, including schema definition, labeling guidelines, and quality control processes.
  • Work closely with research and engineering teams to improve model performance, scalability, and robustness.
  • Conduct experiments, perform data analysis, and clearly document methodologies and findings.
  • Explore and test new tools, frameworks, and best practices for enhancing LLM systems and AI agent capabilities.

• Currently pursuing or recently completed a Degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline. PHD is Bonus.
  • Solid understanding of machine learning and deep learning fundamentals.
  • Familiarity with transformer models, LLMs (e.g., LLaMA, Qwen), or related technologies is a strong plus.
  • Experience or interest in prompt engineering, fine-tuning methods (e.g., LoRA, QLoRA), and model evaluation techniques.
  • Basic knowledge of data annotation workflows and labeling tools.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; able to work both independently and collaboratively.
  • Fluency in English is required to be able to coordinate with overseas partners and stakeholders. Additional languages would be an advantage.

lists.content: You will join the Macro Research team within Binance Research, the function behind the firm’s externally published thought leadership and the market narratives that shape how digital assets are understood, as well as the strategic intelligence relied on internally. The team’s work spans the macro backdrop for digital assets, market structure and regulation, and the structural themes shaping the industry, from tokenization and real-world assets to DeFi, and it reaches a global audience of institutions, media, and the wider crypto community.

• Support the Macro Research team across the full research cycle, from data gathering and chart production to drafting and fact-checking.

  • Help produce the team’s industry and thematic research.

  • Track macro and crypto-market developments, from rates, liquidity, and capital flows to regulation, market structure, and emerging themes, drawing on market data, on-chain data, and other sources to surface what matters.

  • Build and maintain the datasets, models, and visualizations that underpin the team’s research.

  • Bring strong attention to detail to every analysis, alongside genuine curiosity about where the market is heading.

• Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree; Finance, Economics, Computer Science, or a related field is a plus.

  • Good knowledge of crypto and a genuine passion for the industry; familiarity with macro and markets is a plus.

  • Comfortable working with data and translating it into clear analysis and well-designed charts; familiarity with data tools and on-chain analytics is a plus.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, self-driven, with strong work ethic and the ability to thrive in a high-pressure, fast-paced environment.

  • Able to commit a minimum of 3 days per week for at least 6 months.

lists.content:
• Assist the Earn Regulatory team with daily compliance project management and product operations across Simple Earn, Staking, On-Chain Yields, Loans, and related products.

  • Track and manage regulatory project timelines, deliverables, and dependencies end-to-end — ensuring milestones, sign-offs, and confirmation deadlines are met across jurisdictions.

  • Prepare and maintain Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), compliance trackers, meeting summaries, and status reports for ongoing regulatory requirements, product suggestions & workstreams.

  • Coordinate and align on a regular basis with cross-functional stakeholders (Legal, Product, Engineering, local compliance teams, and regional leads) as well as internal stakeholders within Binance Earn.

  • Monitor regulatory developments and product configuration changes across markets, flagging risks and open issues to the team proactively.

  • Act as the DRP (Direct Responsible Person) or POC (Point of Contact) for assigned regulatory workstreams — chasing action items, documenting decisions, and following up with stakeholders on outstanding deliverables.

  • Support regulatory reviews of product configurations (e.g. product availability, whitelist/blacklist logic, UI/wording changes) by consolidating requirements and evidence from multiple teams.

  • Help maintain accurate records and audit trails of regulatory decisions, approvals, and remediation actions across all jurisdictions.

  • Support the broader Earn Growth agenda where regulatory and growth workstreams intersect — e.g. market openings, product launches, and TVL initiatives — ensuring compliance requirements are embedded in execution.

  • Assist with ad-hoc regulatory analysis, data requests, and presentation materials for internal and external stakeholders.

• 0–2 years of relevant experience (internship or entry-level) in project management

  • Strong interest in crypto, DeFi, and Web3 regulation — a proactive habit of researching regulatory and industry developments is highly valued.

  • Familiarity with or willingness to learn crypto regulatory frameworks across key jurisdictions (e.g. MiCA/EU, ADGM/FSRA, UK FCA, HK SFC, PH SEC, Japan FSA) — prior exposure to any of these is a strong plus.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and accountability 

  • Highly organized, with proven ability to track multiple concurrent projects, dependencies, and deadlines across time zones.

  • Excellent logical thinking, written communication, and presentation skills 

  • Comfortable coordinating across large cross-functional teams and managing stakeholder follow-ups independently.

  • Takes full ownership of tasks and outcomes, not just inputs. Self-learning personality and ability to work independently and resolve problems end to end as the DRP/POC. 

  • Ability to handle a fast-paced environment with changing requirements based on regulatory and business needs 

  • Bilingual English/Mandarin is required to be able to coordinate with overseas partners and stakeholders; based in Asia time zone UTC+8 (±2) is preferred.

  • Openness to feedback and a strong willingness to continuously improve.

  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally in large teams and managing stakeholder relations is necessary.

  • Have read and understood Binance’s Core Values & CZ’s Principle.

• During the interview rounds, candidates may be required to complete a practical assignment followed by a final presentation to demonstrate attention to detail, business sense, and structured thinking.

lists.content:
The Social Media and Content Intern supports the social team in producing native, platform-first content for TikTok, Instagram (Reels), X, and YouTube (Shorts). This is a hands-on, on-camera and in-edit role: the intern is expected to ideate, appear in, shoot, and edit short-form video  and to move fast on emerging trends so the brand stays culturally current.

This role suits someone who lives on these platforms, understands their visual language, and can turn a brief (or a trending format) into a finished, publish-ready clip with minimal supervision.

This role will support the social media team across content creation, publishing, community management, creator coordination, and reporting.

 

Key responsibilities include:

  • Create short-form video content for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts, from concept to publish-ready edit.
  • Appear on camera for relevant formats, including explainers, trends, street-style content, and scripted or semi-scripted videos.
  • Monitor TikTok, Instagram, X, and YouTube for emerging trends, sounds, formats, and challenges, and help turn relevant trends into timely content.
  • Apply strong hook and retention thinking across content, using visual, audio, and narrative techniques to improve watch-through.
  • Edit videos using CapCut and native platform tools, ensuring captions, pacing, transitions, sound sync, and safe zones follow platform best practices.
  • Adapt content for each platform rather than cross-posting identical versions.
  • Schedule and publish approved content across TikTok, Instagram, X, and YouTube, including captions, hashtags, tags, cover frames, alt text, and QA checks.
  • Maintain the content calendar, asset trackers, and publishing statuses.
  • Support social listening by tracking brand mentions, keywords, competitor activity, sentiment shifts, and relevant conversation trends.
  • Monitor comments, DMs, and mentions, draft approved responses, and escalate sensitive or compliance-related queries.
  • Support the MENAP Creator Program by managing creator communications, distributing weekly briefs, tracking deliverables, logging content links, and flagging missed deadlines or off-brief content.
  • Help maintain the creator database and scout potential new creators across TikTok, Instagram, X, and YouTube.
  • Pull social performance metrics and support weekly or monthly reporting, highlighting learnings around engagement, retention, and content performance.
    •  

    Expected Deliverables

    • 3–5 publish-ready short-form videos per week.
    • Scheduled and published posts in line with the content calendar.
    • Weekly trend shortlist with recommended formats or sounds.
    • Weekly social listening highlights.
    • Updated MENAP Creator Program tracker and weekly creator briefing distribution.
    • Community management support with escalations logged.
    • Input into weekly or monthly performance reporting.
    • Participation in weekly planning and review sessions.

- Proven ability to create short-form content for TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube Shorts (portfolio, personal account, or previous work).

- Comfortable and natural on camera.

- Deep, current understanding of TikTok, Instagram, X, and YouTube trends and culture, with the instinct to move fast.

- Strong understanding of hooks (visual, audio, and video) and how they drive retention.

- Proficient in CapCut and Instagram's native editing tools.

- Strong sense of pacing, framing, and platform-native visual language.

- Organized, deadline-driven, and able to work with minimal supervision.

- Strong written communication and relationship-management skills  able to interact professionally with external creators and represent the brand in outreach.

- Comfortable learning and working in social media tools (publishing/scheduling, listening, and analytics platforms).

- Bilingual English/Urdu is required to be able to coordinate with overseas partners and stakeholders. Additional languages would be an advantage.

Preferred Qualifications

- Familiarity with the fintech and crypto space, and interest in creating content for a brand like Binance.

- Prior hands-on experience with publishing, listening, or analytics tools [e.g. Sprinklr, Hootsuite, Brandwatch, Talkwalker].

- Experience creating content for a brand or business account (not only personal).

- Basic shooting/lighting knowledge for phone-first production.

- Familiarity with social analytics (views, retention, engagement) and using them to improve content.

About the Role
We're building the core Agent capabilities and Skill ecosystem for Binance Agentic. We're looking for a Product Manager Intern with a strong interest in AI and Web3 to support Agent product design, the Harness evaluation framework, end-to-end task validation, and continuous iteration.

As an intern, you'll work alongside our PM team to explore how AI Agents can solve real Web3 problems — gaining hands-on experience in product design, evaluation frameworks, and cross-functional delivery within a fast-moving crypto exchange environment.

lists.content:
• Shadow and assist in designing Agent-related capabilities across Binance Agentic, including task flows, user interaction patterns, capability boundaries, failure fallbacks, and result feedback loops.
    Harness & Evaluation
  • Help build and maintain the Harness framework — contribute to test scenario design, evaluation criteria, task set curation, performance analysis, and iteration recommendations.
    Cross-functional Collaboration
  • Partner with Tech Owners, frontend engineers, and Skill design leads to learn how business requirements are broken down into shippable, testable, production-ready product specs.
    Web3 Use Case Research
  • Research and map high-value, deployable Agent use cases across Web3 Wallet, Account, Payment, Trading, and other Binance business lines.
    Industry Tracking
  • Stay current on AI Agent, MCP, tool-calling, prompt engineering, and automated evaluation developments — and translate insights into product ideas for the team.
    Metrics & Quality
  • Assist in defining and tracking Agent performance metrics, including task success rate, user satisfaction, error rate, response quality, and tool-calling accuracy.
    Continuous Improvement
  • Help identify issues from real-world Agent usage and support improvements across product, engineering, and operations.

• Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science
  • Strong interest in AI products, Agent products, AIGC applications, automation tools, or developer tooling.
  • Interest in or exposure to Web3, exchanges, wallets, payments, on-chain transactions, DeFi, or crypto assets.
  • Basic understanding of how AI Agents work — tool-calling, task planning, context management, or evaluation frameworks (coursework, projects, or self-study all count).
  • Strong ownership and learning agility; comfortable navigating ambiguity and picking things up quickly.
  • Solid product fundamentals — able to write clear PRDs, flow diagrams, test cases, and acceptance criteria (even at a learning level).
  • Excellent communication skills across engineering, design, operations, and business stakeholders.

• Personal projects or coursework related to AI Agents, prompt engineering, or LLM applications.
  • Experience with or exposure to exchanges, Web3 wallets, on-chain trading, payments, or fintech products.
  • Familiarity with MCP, Function Calling, RAG, multi-Agent orchestration, or workflow automation.
  • Knowledge of the Binance ecosystem or mainstream Web3 user scenarios.
  • Fluency in English is required to be able to coordinate with overseas stakeholders and effectively review and keep up with global AI and Web3 product and technical materials. Additional languages would be an advantage.

descriptionPlain:
Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, Web3 features, and more. We leverage the power of digital assets and blockchain to build an inclusive financial ecosystem to advance the freedom of money and improve financial access for people around the world.


About the team
 
We are looking for a talented Quality Assurance Engineer who has a passion for software and quality. This individual will work closely with engineers and the product team to review new features as well as develop and execute test scenarios which will help improve the quality of our software for Binance Wallet. You will also help the QA team become more efficient by contributing to writing automated tests for our mobile/web/browser extension apps.
